system.description:
Play the Bravo if you want to turn fear and danger into strength.

Features

Courage. When you fail a roll with Fear, you gain a Hope. Once per Rest, before facing overwhelming odds, describe how you steady yourself - clear 1 Stress and gain 1 Hope.

Rise to the Challenge. When you are reduced to 2 or fewer HP, your will sharpens. You may roll a d20 as your Hope Die.
